stores.name: Lam's Seafood
how_to_read: Two flyer images on the specials page. Read both in full.
Check the printed date on each image. On Friday morning the page sometimes still shows last week's flyer; if so, mark the flyer stale.
One image is the Seattle store only; the other covers both the Seattle and Tukwila stores. Items only on the combined image get a note saying they may only be at Tukwila.
Every item is while supplies last.
stores.about: An Asian grocery in the Chinatown–International District with a big fresh seafood counter, inexpensive meat and Asian produce. A second store is in Tukwila.
stores.delivery: Delivers groceries directly. Ask the store about the delivery area and how to order.

stores.name: Uwajimaya
stores.representative_location: Seattle store (all locations share one ad)
how_to_read: Flyer images on the weekly specials page, with a printed "Prices Valid" date range.
Most items print a regular price or an exact "save $X" amount. "Save up to" amounts are not exact and do not count as a printed regular price.
Plain curl gets a Cloudflare 403 on the page itself. Load the weekly-specials page in the headless browser to find the links; the PDF and page images it links download fine with curl.
stores.about: A Pacific Northwest Asian supermarket founded in 1928, best known for Japanese groceries, a seafood counter and a food hall.

stores.name: PCC Community Markets
stores.flyer_url_note: The dedicated sales page has been erroring or empty since September 2026, so the homepage is the only reliable link.
how_to_read: Check the sales section from the homepage. If it shows no items, mark the flyer unreadable.
The site is behind a Cloudflare bot check that blocks both curl and headless browsers. Do not try to get around it. Mark the flyer unreadable with that reason.
stores.about: A member-owned natural foods co-op with stores across the Seattle area, strong on organic produce and local products. Anyone can shop.

stores.name: Central Co-op
how_to_read: Web page listing of fresh deals with regular prices.
The page often keeps showing old dates for weeks. If the printed dates are not this week, mark the flyer stale and use no items from it.
stores.about: A member-owned co-op on East Madison Street in Seattle, with a second store in Tacoma. Organic and local produce and bulk foods.

stores.name: Smith Brothers Farms

sale_period.note: Two-week cycles (for example 10/17 to 10/30). Home delivery, not a store.

how_to_read: The page is rendered with JavaScript. Read the rendered page in a browser; cached fetches go stale.
The cycle dates are printed at the top ("Enjoy these deals 10/17 to 10/30").
In the headless browser, waiting for the network to go idle times out. Wait for the page load, then scroll to the bottom before reading.
stores.about: A Kent dairy that delivers milk, eggs and groceries to homes around Puget Sound. Not a store: sales run in two-week cycles.
stores.delivery: Home delivery is how they sell: groceries come with your milk order.

stores.name: Metropolitan Market
how_to_read: Read the ad in sections, not one screenshot, so nothing is missed.
Printed "Prices effective" date range at the top.
stores.about: A Seattle-area specialty grocery known for prepared foods, wine, and premium meat and produce.

stores.name: Red Apple Markets
stores.flyer_url_note: No store website. The flyer appears as a catalogue on redpepper.digital and its URL changes every week, so each week's file links the exact catalogue pages.
how_to_read: Find this week's catalogue on redpepper.digital and link each page read.
No regular prices are printed. Use US average prices for staples, labeled approximate.

redpepper.digital cannot be browsed from the cloud session. The catalogue page images are on d16fzx5hhs0dp6.cloudfront.net; this week's were found only from last week's links. If no current catalogue can be found, mark the flyer unreadable and say so.
stores.about: Independent neighborhood markets that share the Red Apple name. This site uses the Beacon Hill (Hilltop) store's flyer; other Red Apple stores may have different prices.

locations.label: Dominic's Red Apple (White Center area)
locations.address: 9627 Des Moines Memorial Dr S, Seattle

stores.name: H Mart

sale_period.note: Meat and produce specials often run Friday to Monday only.

stores.representative_location: Washington flyer (Lynnwood, Federal Way, Bellevue and other WA stores)
how_to_read: Pick the Washington flyer. It does not apply to the small 2nd and Pine or University District stores.
Check whether meat and produce prices have a shorter Friday to Monday window and use that as their valid-through date.

hmart.com does not link the Washington flyer. It is an image on images.squarespace-cdn.com; this week's was found only from last week's link. If no current WA flyer can be found, mark the flyer unreadable and say so.
stores.about: A Korean-American supermarket chain with a big produce section, thin-sliced meats for Korean barbecue, and banchan. The Washington flyer covers the larger stores.

stores.name: T&T Supermarket
how_to_read: Use the .us site. tntsupermarket.com is the Canadian site and shows Ontario prices.
The item list loads as you scroll, so read it one category at a time. A single read catches only a fraction of the items.
The site blocks curl (Akamai 403) and headless browsers. A non-headless browser on a virtual display (xvfb) loads it, and the eight flyer page images can then be downloaded from that session.
stores.about: A Canadian Asian supermarket chain with Washington stores in Bellevue and Lynnwood, known for its seafood counter, bakery and hot food.
stores.delivery: Delivers groceries directly from its Washington stores. Check their site for the delivery area and how to order.

stores.name: Grocery Outlet
stores.representative_location: One Seattle store, to be chosen on the first read. Set that location's flyer flag to true here.
how_to_read: The ad is a per-store Flipp catalogue viewer that needs a store selected. Use the same Seattle store every week.
"Compare at" prices are other retailers' prices, not Grocery Outlet's own regular price, so they do not count as a printed regular price.
stores.about: A discount grocery chain selling overstock and closeout brand-name food at low prices. Stock changes constantly, and deals vary by store.

locations.label: Central District
locations.address: 1126 Martin Luther King Jr Way, Seattle

locations.label: Federal Way
locations.address: 1618 SW Dash Point Rd, Federal Way

stores.name: 99 Ranch Market
stores.flyer_url_note: The weekly ad is per store inside the site's web app. Once the Kent store's weekly ad link is confirmed on the first read, put it here.
how_to_read: Rendered with JavaScript. Choose the Kent store, open its weekly ad, and read the rendered page.
Confirm on the first read whether regular prices are printed, and update prints_regular_prices if they are.

The Kent store's ad is server-rendered: fetch https://www.99ranch.com/stores/promotions/1791 with curl and read storeActivities from the __NEXT_DATA__ JSON. Each entry is a dated ad image on img.awsprod.99ranch.com. No browser needed.
stores.about: A large Chinese and Taiwanese-American supermarket chain. The nearest stores are in Kent and Edmonds.

stores.name: Viet-Wah
stores.flyer_url_note: Each week is a new post, for example https://www.vietwah.com/single-post/weekly-ad-oct-23-29-2026. Link that week's post.
how_to_read: Open the newest "Weekly Ad" post on the blog page. The ad is an image, with a PDF version further down the post.
Confirm on the first read whether regular prices are printed, and update prints_regular_prices if they are.
The PDF link appears only after clicking Download PDF in a browser; after that, curl can fetch it.
stores.about: A Vietnamese and pan-Asian supermarket. Its original Chinatown–International District store closed in 2022; today's store is in Renton.

stores.name: Seafood City
stores.flyer_url_note: The Tukwila store's page. Its Weekly Sale section loads with JavaScript; use View All to see every item.

sale_period.note: Confirm the sale days on the first read and update this entry.

how_to_read: Open the Tukwila store page, then View All under Weekly Sale, and read the rendered list.
Confirm on the first read whether regular prices are printed and which days the sale runs, and update this entry.
The Seattle weekly ad at https://seafoodcity.com/weekly-ads is one poster image on cdn.localexpress.io, with printed dates and WAS prices.
stores.about: A Filipino supermarket chain. The Tukwila store at Westfield Southcenter has a seafood market, Filipino groceries and food stalls.

stores.name: Asian Family Market
stores.flyer_url_note: Weekly specials are a poster image on the homepage, with tabs for each store. Use the Seattle tab.

sale_period.note: The poster says "This Week Only" but prints no dates.

how_to_read: Open the homepage weekly specials, choose the Seattle tab, and enlarge the poster to read it.
No dates are printed, so record valid dates as null. If the poster is identical to last week's, mark the flyer stale.
Confirm on the first read whether regular prices are printed.

The weekly specials posters are on the homepage behind store tabs (Bellevue, Seattle, Tukwila); click the Seattle tab in the headless browser. The Seattle poster can be very large (about 50 MB); download it with curl and crop it with ImageMagick.
stores.about: An Asian supermarket with stores on Aurora Avenue North in Seattle, in Bellevue and in Tukwila. Each store posts its own weekly poster.

stores.name: Hau Hau Market
stores.flyer_url_note: No online flyer found (checked 2026-10-23). Listed for its location only; prices are not tracked.
how_to_read: No online flyer. Not part of the weekly routine.
stores.about: A small Chinese and Vietnamese grocery in Little Saigon, known locally for low prices on produce, meat and seafood. No online flyer.

stores.name: Dong Hing Market
stores.flyer_url_note: No online flyer found (checked 2026-10-23). Listed for its location only; prices are not tracked.
how_to_read: No online flyer. Not part of the weekly routine.
stores.about: A Chinese grocery on South Jackson Street in Little Saigon, with produce, meat and pantry staples. No online flyer.
